Universal Robots introduces its AI-ready Gen 7 platform

The new generation combines PolyScope X, updated robot arms, controllers and teaching interfaces for industrial automation.

RoboticsTomorrow ↗15 September 2026English editorial summary
Story

A platform-wide update

Universal Robots introduced its seventh-generation platform at IMTS, with PolyScope X at its core. The update spans the controller, teach pendant and tool connections to support industrial applications that use AI.

New arms and controller hardware

The g-Series includes UR10g-1750, UR17g-1300 and UR18g-950 arms, with the names indicating payload and reach. Universal Robots says its CB7 Core controller provides 40% more processing power in a package 30% smaller, with support for multiple factory networks.

Connections for vision and AI

The tool flange provides data, power and connections needed for cameras and sensors. Force and torque sensing, APIs and ROS2 communication are intended to help integrators develop additional applications.

Making teaching easier

The TP7 Core pendant is more than 20% lighter, while the SP7 Smart Panel supports teaching close to the task. More than 20 partners contributed demonstrations. Users still need to select hardware and software suited to each application.
